title: Hydroelectric turbine
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the page 33 Francis hydroelectric turbine uses a raised reservoir, intake gate, supply passage, spiral casing, guide vanes, curved runner, central downward outlet and a shaft coupled to a generator and external indicator lamp. Open gate admits water, rotates the runner and generator, and powers the lamp. Reduce flow compares lower water input at the same head and electrical load. Close gate removes the driving flow and output falls. See-through follows water around the casing, through the guide vanes and runner, and down the central outlet. The lamp and bench water supply are teaching fixtures. Do not add adjustable vanes, a self-powered recirculation loop or unsupported generator internals.
blurb: A teaching adaptation of the page 33 Francis turbine links guided water flow to a runner, generator and external indicator lamp.
adaptation: Raised ideal constant-head reservoir and separate catch tray are teaching fixtures. The external supply is idealized, with no return loop. The lamp is an external load. No adjustable vanes or unsupported generator internals. Normalized qualitative flow and output are not calibrated performance.
